Here’s a **starter list of notable Sherlock Holmes movies** — there are *many* adaptations, including silent films, TV movies, and foreign-language versions. Sherlock Holmes is one of the most-adapted fictional characters in film and TV. ([en.wikipedia.org](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Adaptations_of_Sherlock_Holmes?utm_source=openai))

## Major / famous Sherlock Holmes movies

### Early & classic films
1. **Sherlock Holmes** — 1916 — William Gillette  
2. **Sherlock Holmes** — 1922 — John Barrymore  
3. **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 1939 — Basil Rathbone  
4. **The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes** — 1939 — Basil Rathbone  

### Basil Rathbone film series
5. **Sherlock Holmes and the Voice of Terror** — 1942  
6. **Sherlock Holmes and the Secret Weapon** — 1942  
7. **Sherlock Holmes in Washington** — 1943  
8. **Sherlock Holmes Faces Death** — 1943  
9. **The Spider Woman** — 1943  
10. **The Scarlet Claw** — 1944  
11. **The Pearl of Death** — 1944  
12. **The House of Fear** — 1945  
13. **The Woman in Green** — 1945  
14. **Pursuit to Algiers** — 1945  
15. **Terror by Night** — 1946  
16. **Dressed to Kill** — 1946  

### Later well-known films
17. **The Hound of the Baskervilles** — 1959 — Peter Cushing  
18. **A Study in Terror** — 1965  
19. **The Private Life of Sherlock Holmes** — 1970  
20. **The Seven-Per-Cent Solution** — 1976  
21. **Murder by Decree** — 1979  
22. **Young Sherlock Holmes** — 1985  
23. **Without a Clue** — 1988  
24. **The Great Mouse Detective** — 1986 — animated Disney film inspired by Holmes  
25. **Sherlock Holmes and the Case of the Silk Stocking** — 2004  
26. **Sherlock Holmes** — 2009 — Robert Downey Jr., Jude Law  
27. **Sherlock Holmes: A Game of Shadows** — 2011 — sequel to the 2009 film  
28. **Mr. Holmes** — 2015 — Ian McKellen  
29. **Holmes & Watson** — 2018 — comedy  
30. **Enola Holmes** — 2020 — focuses on Sherlock’s sister  
31. **Enola Holmes 2** — 2022  

## Popular Sherlock Holmes TV/movie adaptations also worth watching
- **The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson** — 1979–1986 Soviet TV film series  
- **The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes** — 1984–1994 Jeremy Brett series  
- **Sherlock** — 2010–2017 BBC series with Benedict Cumberbatch  
- **Elementary** — 2012–2019 with Jonny Lee Miller  
- **Miss Sherlock** — 2018 Japanese adaptation  

If you want, I can also give you a **complete chronological list** or a **best-to-watch ranking**.
